- Lowe’s was the subject of unusually high call-option activity: 13,431 calls were purchased, 63% above the typical 8,224 contracts (MarketBeat, Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated).[2]
- Bernstein analyst Zhihan Ma maintained a Buy rating and a $254 price target in a report released October 14, 2026 (Business Insider, Oct 14 2026; publish time not stated).[8]

- The reported analyst consensus was Moderate Buy, with an average price target of $254.29 (MarketBeat, Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated).[2]
- Representative Kevin Hern sold Lowe’s shares; the report did not disclose the number of shares or transaction value (MarketBeat, Oct 15 2026; publish time not stated).[3]
- No company-specific operating, legal, regulatory, product, transaction, or earnings catalyst with a publication time inside the requested window was identified in the available results.
